title: The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, December 10, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, December 10, 2018 Posted by admin on December 10th, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. Dow stock 52 week lows include Goldman Sachs (GS).
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -42 points.
Friday the Dow was down -558.72 (-2.24%) at 24,388.95.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -1.34%.
There were no Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were not to be found.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Intel (INTC) -4.40%, Cisco (CSCO) -4.03%, Microsoft (MSFT) -4.00%, DowDuPont (DWDP) -3.88%, Caterpillar (CAT) -3.75%, IBM (IBM) -3.69%, Apple (AAPL) -3.57%, Nike (NKE) -2.91%, Visa (V) -2.79% and UnitedHealth (UNH) -2.77%.
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down three-tenths of a cent at $2.420 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
Walgreens (WBA) reports earnings on 12/20/2018 before the market open.
Nike (NKE) reports earnings on 12/20/2018 after the market close.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
3M (MMM)
3m (MMM) is down -15.78% year-to-date. In the past 52 weeks, 3M share prices have been bracketed by a low of $181.98 and a high of $259.77 and are now at $199.75, 10% above that low price.
